Differentiation gives D_prime=(h/L)phi and strict positive derivative of EN. Positivity and sharp endpoint arguments cover all parameters. An independent stdlib Monte Carlo edge-crossing checker retained 241034 sections and agreed with the exact quadrature across five shapes.

value.rationale: The distribution of section polygon types under Crofton-invariant random flats is a natural geometric-probability observable. The claim simultaneously gives an exact complete law for all anisotropic right rectangular pyramids, the necessary width-biased conditioning, strict height monotonicity, an all-shape sharp expectation interval, and a uniform counterintuitive inequality P(triangle)>P(pentagon). These are structural constraints across a natural two-parameter similarity family and are not isolated sample computations.
